assessments.name: Project proposal
assessments.description: Write a proposal that outlines your vision for a project and your specific role within it. This proposal should demonstrate that you understand the technical landscape, have thought through feasibility, and have a clear plan for execution.

assessments.name: Mid-project demonstration
assessments.description: Demonstrate your working prototype and submit a progress report documenting what you've built so far. The demo should show a functional (even if incomplete) system that processes real transit data and produces some form of output.

assessments.name: Final deliverable
assessments.description: 20 minute live demonstration + 10 minutes of questions

assessments.name: Final report
assessments.description: Write a comprehensive individual report that reflects on the entire project. This report should demonstrate your personal understanding of the work, your specific contributions, and your learning throughout the semester.
